subject: Your 2AM meeting just found a home
preview_text: The 75-second habit that turns chaotic calls into searchable action items. Watch this.
body_paragraphs: You know that rush when a 2AM brainstorm hits—and by morning half the ideas are gone? I’ve been there. One founder told me he lost a six-figure partnership because he forgot a single detail from a late-night call. That’s why I’m writing this at 10PM, coffee in hand, to show you a 75-second trick that locks every idea down.

Here’s the hack: after any meeting, open Smart Notes and tap the one-tap recording button—even if the call is already over. The app keeps a 30-second buffer, so you can capture the last thing said. Then, in under a minute, it transcribes and generates a structured summary with key points and action items. No rewriting, no forgetting.

You already have this power in your pocket. The profile language controls let you set your meeting language to match—so transcripts are clean, even with accents. And shareable notes mean your team wakes up to clarity, not chaos. This isn’t a feature; it’s a lifeline for your 2AM self.

Open the app now and record your next thought—even a voice memo. See how it feels to never lose a key point again. P.S. Premium users get unlimited transcripts and language-aware summaries. Your free trial is waiting—check the settings tab.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
